text:
With the unfortunate Terry McLaurin injury, Antonio Williams is a massive riser in my rest of season rankings (top 100 player, WR41).

Williams has looked good when given the opportunity in 2026, separating well (top 30 win rate) and showing juice after the catch (massive YAC play called back in Wk4).

A big difference from earlier in the year, the Commanders were willing to use him on the outside more in Week 6 when Terry went down. He had a 55% slot rate prior to Week 6, but was at just 30% this past week, while leading the team in routes.

Daniels has not been great as a passer this year (21st of 33 QBs in YPA), but the pass game showed signs of life in the 2nd half of the Monday Night game. Williams has a real chance to be the best receiver on this offense down the stretch, and a very good chance to be a top 2 target.
